email.name: Elena Marsh
email.subject: Arriving Friday - a few questions
email.body:
Hi there,

We're checking in this Friday (booking BR-1042) and I have a few questions:

1. We'd love to bring our dog Biscuit. She's about 30 lbs. Is that OK and what's the fee?
2. Could we check out late on Monday? I'm a Gold member.
3. Can you arrange a pickup from MIA for the two of us on Friday afternoon? Our flight lands at 2:15 PM.

Thanks so much!
Elena

record.draft:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for your email. I'm glad to help with your stay on booking BR-1042 (Fri 6 Nov to Mon 9 Nov).

1. Biscuit: Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, so a 30 lb dog is fine. There is a $75 pet fee per stay, which is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1].

2. Late check-out on Monday: Your Gold membership gives you late check-out until 2:00 PM, subject to availability [P7][P4]. I've asked our front desk team to confirm this for your Monday departure.

3. MIA pickup: We can arrange a sedan from MIA for up to 3 guests at $65 one way. It must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P10]. I've sent your request to our reservations team to book it for your 2:15 PM arrival on Friday. Could you please send your flight number so we can track the arrival?

The team will confirm all details and the total with you shortly.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Warm regards,

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and your dogs on 13 November.

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Your two dogs fit within that limit.

Early check-in: Our standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and cannot be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We have asked our front desk to check whether your cabin can be ready around noon, and the team will confirm with you.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way, runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We have requested a shuttle for your three guests on Friday after an 11 AM landing. The team will confirm the booking and pickup time.

A manager will not be needed for these requests, and the team will follow up shortly.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Guest Services, Beach Resort

Elena

Dear Elena,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you on Friday 6 November.

1. Biscuit: Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of two dogs per room, so Biscuit is welcome. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant. We have noted her on your booking for the team.

2. Late checkout: As a Gold member, your tier includes late checkout until 2:00 PM [P8]. Weekend late checkout is capped at 12:00 PM, but Monday is not a weekend day [P7]. Availability is subject to confirmation, so we have sent your request to our front desk team, who will confirm.

3. MIA pickup: We offer sedan pickups from MIA at $65 one way for up to 3 guests, and they must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P11]. We have sent your Friday 2:15 PM arrival request to our reservations team, who will confirm the booking and total with you.

A manager will not be needed for these; our team will reply to confirm the details.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hello Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We're dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way. It runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P9]. We've sent your request for three guests landing around 11:00 AM; our concierge team will confirm the booking with you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

record.draft:
Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Sobre su reserva del 20 al 22 de noviembre de 2026 (habitación Standard Queen, 104):

Desayuno: Sí, un desayuno continental está incluido en todas las tarifas, servido de 7:00 a 10:00 AM en el Great Room. No tenemos restaurante ni servicio a la habitación, aunque puede pedir comida de restaurantes locales para que se entregue en recepción [P1].

Mascotas: Lamentablemente, no admitimos gatos ni otras mascotas que no sean perros [P4]. Sí somos pet-friendly para perros (hasta 2 por habitación, con una tarifa de $50 por noche por habitación, con un máximo de $200 por estancia) [P4].

Un gerente del equipo confirmará cualquier detalle adicional de su reserva.

Con cariño,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Parking is valet only at $45 per night, with in/out privileges [P6].

Yes, there is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax, which includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P4].

If you have any questions about your December dates, just let us know and we will be glad to help.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort
